skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply accounting principles and practices in public sector organizations.
Analyze financial statements and assess the financial health of public sector organizations.
Evaluate and critique accounting policies and practices in public sector organizations.
Work independently and collaboratively in the context of public sector accounting.
Manage resources and improve the efficiency of public sector operations.
Effectively communicate accounting concepts and findings in an international context.
Apply professional ethics and responsibilities in public accounting.
